subject: Weighted Survey Data: Is it possible?

messages.author: e86a356e675fe0d9
messages.subject: Weighted Survey Data: Is it possible?
parts:
I'm hoping to do some analysis on survey data where the responses have an attached weight based on the wider, global population.

Does anyone know if there is functionality in tidyLPA to account for those weights? All I can find are ways to vary the relative importance of the columns not the rows.

Thank you in advance,
Meghan
